## Capability / user problem
What should an agent be able to do that is not covered well today?

## Example requests
Provide 2–5 realistic prompts that should route to this capability.

## Existing overlap
Which current skills overlap, and why are they insufficient?

## Candidate source
If proposing an upstream skill, include repository/path, author/collection, license, and why this source is a good fit. If proposing an original skill, list authoritative standards/docs it should use.

## Routing placement
Which domain/lifecycle/specialization track should own it?
